title: TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Charge Computation
content:
**Fee accounting bulletin - TRICARE Prime catch-up installment.**

## The calculation

A catch-up installment bills every month from the month the reinstatement review was filed through the month before the current month that no monthly installment charge on the account begins in, and its charge is the plan year's annual fee less the installment charges on the account whose coverage begins in the current plan year on or before today, TRICARE Select coverage taking nothing off it. The annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement is the tier's annual individual fee for an individual arrangement and its annual family fee for a family arrangement.

## Terms used

- **Monthly rate and quarterly installment.** Each month is valued at one twelfth of the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (the annual fee divided by 12), rounded to the cent, and a quarterly installment at one quarter of that annual fee (the annual fee divided by 4), rounded to the cent.
- **When a charge begins.** Every installment charge on the account begins on the first day of the period it covers, except a first installment, which begins on the enrollment's effective date; a charge begins in the month containing that day.
- **Months.** Months are calendar months, counted on one continuous calendar sequence from January 2000 onward, so a span "from" one month "through" another includes both of them. The current plan year is the calendar year containing today.
- **Coverage period of the charge.** The catch-up installment's coverage period runs from the first day of the first month it bills to the last day of the last month it bills, it carries the installment frequency of the enrollment's payment arrangement, and it falls due on the day it is posted.
- **Result.** The catch-up charge is never below zero and is rounded to the cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A enrollment with an individual arrangement (annual fee 390.12) and monthly installments; today is in August; the reinstatement review was filed in April.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Installment charges whose coverage begins in the current plan year on or before today | January 32.51, February 32.51, March 32.51, August 32.51 - total 130.04 |
| Months billed: April through July, none of which has a monthly charge beginning in it | 4 months; coverage period 1 April to 31 July |
| Charge: 390.12 less 130.04 | 260.08 |

## Second figure (hypothetical)

Same enrollment, but the installment charges beginning in the current plan year total 400.00: 390.12 less 400.00 is below zero, so the charge is 0.00.
